verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies bulk capability. The docs describe pushing existing data from a primary database or CSV/JSON file into Typesense, and the Cloud MCP server says an agent can "index your data" from the conversation, which suggests batch ingestion. No evidence explicitly documents a bulk import, bulk update, or bulk delete endpoint, so most of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a bulk/batch import API, bulk update/upsert and delete-by-filter operations, agent-driven bulk operations via MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
